artifact_classes.rationale: Permissive reuse with explicit patent-license terms; chosen as a review recommendation, not yet effective.
Broad reuse with attribution; chosen as a review recommendation, not yet effective.
Simple public reuse and attribution default for project-owned datasets; database-rights and third-party-source exceptions still require review.
Open-hardware license with weak reciprocity so modified hardware remains shareable while permitting integration into larger systems; chosen as a review recommendation, not yet effective.

exceptions: Third-party material remains under its original terms and must not be relicensed by this project.
Vendor datasheets, standards text, papers, screenshots, trademarks, and quoted excerpts are not covered unless rights are explicitly held.
Patentability, freedom-to-operate, export-control, privacy, and research-participant obligations are outside the scope of this manifest.
A repository-visible file is not licensed for reuse merely because it is public on GitHub.
